Cumhur Sefer
Cumhur Sefer, a visionary architect, has dedicated his life to the art of architectural design. With over four decades in the industry, he has developed a unique approach to creating modern structures that go beyond conventional forms and embrace diversity. His work has been featured in various books and magazines around the world, showcasing his ability to weave together the arts, humanities, science, and world religions harmoniously.
Cumhur Sefer's background includes training in technology and design, and his approach to architecture adheres to strict values and principles for the production of high-quality products. He founded IC Designery in 1980 with his business partner and employee, Habib Arif Hấym. Despite the challenges and struggles encountered throughout his career, Cumhur has turned them into opportunities for growth through collaboration, innovation, and a commitment to excellence.

Cumhur has dicussed national and international problems, projects, challenges, and innovations related to architecture, science, and arts with a global perspective. His insights into the relationship between science, contemporary culture, and technology have been widely shared and praised.
Cumhur's collaborations with various professions, including architecture, science, technology, and education, have resulted in outcomes that better serve the public, bring joy, and transform lives.
Cumhur licenses formats for use and that he does not need to depend on income for his families, and achieving this crucial goal has allowed him to focus on his work without distractions.
Cumhur Sefer originally designed 53 projects in 1980. Besides IC Designery, he established the Çıkıcı Institutions Center in 1988.
Cumhur has 23 children, 18 grandchildren, a favorite dog named Algın, and the ability to draw, paint, write, and compose music as a child. ForumForum Forum Forums Forum
